Soggetti Essenziali
I Soggetti Essenziali si riferiscono a entità identificate come cruciali per il funzionamento della società, soggetti a regole specifiche.<SEP>I soggetti essenziali sono entità identificate che devono rispettare obblighi specifici e sono soggetti a sanzioni per violazioni.<SEP>Soggetti Essenziali are entities identified as critical for the functioning of society and the economy, whose registration is mandated for cybersecurity purposes under current regulations. These essential entities are crucial because any compromise could result in significant impacts on public services and national security. As such, they are obligated to implement risk management measures related to cybersecurity to protect their information systems and networks.

Under established regulatory frameworks, particularly in relation to cybersecurity, Soggetti Essenziali are required to adhere to specific security obligations and product and service standards as outlined by legal provisions. This compliance is essential for maintaining national security standards, given the sensitive information these entities manage. Furthermore, they must communicate updates regarding their activities and services based on defined criteria and report any significant cybersecurity incidents to CSIRT Italia.

The classification of Soggetti Essenziali transcends the typical thresholds for medium-sized enterprises, encompassing a variety of critical entities regardless of size, as specified by the Direttiva NIS. This comprehensive oversight underscores their vital role in ensuring the stability and security of essential public services and infrastructure, thereby highlighting their importance in safeguarding public safety and health.<SEP>Soggetti Essenziali refers to essential subjects or organizations that are critical to specific regulatory frameworks and their compliance is monitored.

Soggetti Importanti
I Soggetti Importanti sono entità indicate come rilevanti nel contesto di regolamenti specifici, con sanzioni amministrative ridotte.<SEP>Soggetti Importanti refers to important subjects or organizations that play a significant role under regulatory oversight.<SEP>Soggetti Importanti refers to significant entities that require registration for cybersecurity, although they are classified as having an operational value lower than that of essential subjects. These entities provide services that contribute to the security and stability of vital sectors, and while their interruption may have a lesser impact compared to essential subjects, it remains significant enough to warrant regulatory oversight.

Soggetti Importanti are obligated to comply with regulations similar to those imposed on essential subjects, particularly concerning risk management and security measures. They play a crucial role in the implementation of security protocols and are required to communicate and update information about their activities and services. Furthermore, they must report significant incidents to CSIRT Italia, demonstrating their active participation in cybersecurity efforts.

In accordance with the NIS Directive, Soggetti Importanti must adhere to specific cybersecurity regulations as part of their operational responsibilities. They also have the option, though it is not strictly mandated, to voluntarily report cybersecurity incidents affecting their services. Overall, these entities are essential for maintaining a robust cybersecurity landscape and ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulatory obligations, despite not being classified as essential.

Sistemi Informativi e di Rete
I Sistemi Informativi e di Rete comprendono reti di comunicazione e dispositivi interconnessi per la gestione dei dati digitali.<SEP>I Sistemi Informativi e di Rete supportano attività e servizi critici, i cui obblighi sono regolati dall'Autorità Nazionale Competente NIS.<SEP>I sistemi informativi e di rete designano le infrastrutture tecnologiche utilizzate per gestire e fornire servizi, che devono essere protetti da rischi e incidenti.<SEP>Sistemi informativi e di rete sono infrastrutture tecnologiche essenziali per la gestione e l'elaborazione delle informazioni in ambito aziendale.<SEP>Sistemi Informativi e di Rete si riferiscono a network e sistemi digitali utilizzati per conservare, trasmettere o elaborare dati e servizi.

Politiche di Analisi dei Rischi
Le politiche di analisi dei rischi riguardano le strategie e le pratiche per valutare e gestire i rischi legati alla sicurezza informatica.<SEP>Le politiche di analisi dei rischi si concentrano sul valutare e mitigare i potenziali rischi per la sicurezza dei sistemi informativi.

Gestione degli Incidenti
Gestione degli Incidenti include azioni e procedure volte a prevenire e rispondere a incidenti di sicurezza informatica.<SEP>La gestione degli incidenti implica azioni e procedure per prevenire, rilevare e rispondere a incidenti, garantendo il recupero dai danni.<SEP>La gestione degli incidenti implica procedure e strumenti per rispondere a eventi che compromettano la sicurezza dei servizi.<SEP>La gestione degli incidenti include le procedure e gli strumenti necessari per rilevare, rispondere e comunicare in caso di incidenti di sicurezza.

Gruppo di cooperazione NIS is a cooperation group established to follow the guidelines of the EU directive 2022/2555 related to cybersecurity.<SEP>Il Gruppo di cooperazione NIS è un ente responsabile per la gestione degli incidenti e delle crisi informatiche, promuovendo la collaborazione tra le nazioni.<SEP>The Gruppo di cooperazione NIS is an organization that coordinates cybersecurity activities and policies among EU member states in accordance with European regulations. It comprises national authorities responsible for NIS and designated points of contact within the member states, aiming to enhance trust and cooperation in matters of network and information security. This cooperation group plays a critical role in conducting coordinated risk assessments to safeguard the security of critical supply chains. By facilitating collaboration among member states, the Gruppo di cooperazione NIS strives to improve the overall cybersecurity posture across the European Union.<SEP>Il Gruppo di cooperazione NIS è un organismo creato per facilitare la cooperazione tra autorità nazionali sui temi di sicurezza informatica, in conformità con la direttiva NIS.<SEP>The Gruppo di cooperazione NIS is a cooperation group established under EU directives to enhance cybersecurity resilience among member states.

NIS
NIS (Network and Information Systems) is a set of regulations established to enhance the overall cybersecurity posture of network and information systems across EU member states.<SEP>The term NIS refers to the directive of the European Union concerning the security of networks and information systems, which serves as the foundation for the national competent authority responsible for this area. NIS is actively involved in cooperation initiatives, particularly in relation to compliance and regulatory measures. NIS plays a crucial role as a liaison for communication and information exchange regarding cybersecurity measures and agreements. Moreover, it is the national competent authority mentioned in the context of digital platforms and information modification. Additionally, NIS is responsible for the registration and communication processes concerning essential and important subjects as stipulated in the applicable decree. Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale
The Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale is an authoritative agency tasked with ensuring cybersecurity and establishing measures for sanctioning violations.<SEP>The Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale is responsible for national cybersecurity in Italy and receives budget allocations from administrative sanctions.<SEP>The Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale is the agency dedicated to cybersecurity in Italy, receiving funds from administrative penalties.<SEP>The Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale is the national authority responsible for cybersecurity in Italy. It operates as the competent authority under the NIS (Network and Information Security) directive and is an integral part of the Italian CSIRT (Computer Security Incident Response Team). The agency plays a pivotal role in coordinating cybersecurity efforts and policies, and it works closely with the Presidency of the Council of Ministers to enhance national cybersecurity.

The Agenzia intervenes in significant cybersecurity incidents, ensuring a structured response and management. Its responsibilities encompass implementing technical measures to promote a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy across the country. Moreover, it establishes mandates and methods to ensure compliance and monitor relevant subjects in line with the NIS decree.

In addition to focusing on national cyber resilience, the agency is dedicated to protecting critical infrastructures and maintaining the overall information security of the state. It is also involved in the review of cybersecurity practices and designating experts for inspections, reflecting its comprehensive role in safeguarding Italy’s cybersecurity landscape. The agency is tasked with implementing the National Cybersecurity Strategy and coordinating national cybersecurity efforts, underlining its central function in fortifying the nation's information security systems.

Agenzia per la cybersicurezza nazionale
The Agenzia per la cybersicurezza nazionale is the national agency responsible for cybersecurity coordination and incident management in Italy, designated as the single point of contact under NIS directives.<SEP>The Agenzia per la cybersicurezza nazionale, known in English as the Agency for National Cybersecurity, is a governmental agency in Italy responsible for national cybersecurity policies and their implementation. It holds the mandate to assess and periodically update the national cybersecurity strategy in Italy, ensuring that the country is equipped to handle evolving cybersecurity challenges.

As the national authority for cybersecurity, the agency coordinates Italy's cybersecurity efforts and serves as a key point of contact for issues related to the European Union's NIS Directive. This role includes facilitating cooperation between national authorities and other EU member states, thereby enhancing collective cybersecurity resilience across Europe.

The Agenzia is tasked with enforcing compliance among service providers and overseeing the implementation of national cybersecurity policies and measures. Its responsibilities extend to managing significant cyber incidents and coordinating crisis management efforts in line with EU directives. It plays a critical role in safeguarding Italy's cybersecurity infrastructure by overseeing information security activities as mandated by various laws and decrees.

Furthermore, the Agenzia per la cybersicurezza nazionale functions as the national Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), emphasizing its essential role in cybersecurity coordination. It implements technical solutions to support a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy and provides guidance on technical specifications to address cybersecurity threats effectively.

In summary, the Agenzia per la cybersicurezza nazionale is integral to establishing and maintaining cybersecurity standards in Italy. It manages national cybersecurity initiatives and facilitates the sharing of information regarding cybersecurity threats, ensuring the security and resilience of Italy's cyber ecosystem.<SEP>The National Cybersecurity Agency is responsible for coordinating security efforts and responses to cybersecurity incidents in Italy.

The Tavolo per l'attuazione della disciplina NIS is an essential body established in Italy to support the national competent authority in effectively implementing the NIS (Network and Information Systems) directive. This collaborative working group plays a crucial role in ensuring coordination among various stakeholders involved in the governance of cybersecurity standards and practices within the country. As a permanent entity, the Tavolo meets periodically to discuss and carry out its mandate related to the NIS directive, focusing on the implementation of specific regulations and frameworks aimed at enhancing cybersecurity protocols. These entities are required to implement robust cybersecurity measures and comply with specific regulations established by the NIS directive. They must conform to cybersecurity norms and utilize certified TIC products and services. Supported by CSIRT Italia, these essential entities are subject to stringent obligations aimed at safeguarding their operations and ensuring the security of the services they provide.
